name: - sDAO
fix_description: Add OnlyOperator or onlyOwner modifier to withdrawTeam(). Currently any external caller can trigger withdrawal of all contract funds to the TEAM address.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-call exploit caused by an obvious missing validation/access-control issue in redeem(), where a fake token contract can spoof underlying() and expiry() and bypass burn semantics. The PoC is very short, requires no flash loans or protocol-specific multi-step setup, and a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly.
